targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-862 (475c, the config-fix requeue of V3-EXQ-475b): the FIRST diagnosed defect (`enable_affective_harm_stream=True` never passed to `build_config`, leaving z_harm_a structurally None) is FIXED and confirmed working -- `n_dacc_fires=451` on seed 42 (was 0 in 475b). But `dacc_bias_nonzero_steps=0` in EVERY seed/arm cell (P2 dACC engagement gate still fails, `p2_on_dacc_fired_seeds=0`), and `dacc_bias_magnitude_series` is pinned at exactly 0.0 with zero spread in all 6 groups. Code-verified root cause: `DACCtoE3Adapter.forward()` (ree_core/cingulate/dacc.py:505-550) computes `weight = self.config.dacc_weight * drive_gain`; when `weight==0.0` (the class default, per the module's own docstring: 'All multipliers default to 0, so with default config the bias is the zero vector regardless of bundle content'), `scaled = torch.zeros_like(mode_ev)` unconditionally -- independent of whether dACC fires or what PE it computes. The driver never sets `dacc_weight` (confirmed by direct grep -- zero mentions in the script). This is a SECOND, distinct config-omission bug of the same class as 475b's (a required non-default flag never set), not a substrate ceiling, not evidence on Q-040c's actual question (whether dACC bias magnitude tracks precision-weighted PE under V_s gating). The new preflight gate added specifically to catch 475b's defect class (`_preflight_dacc_engagement_check`, asserting `pe is not None and bias_mag is not None`) structurally cannot catch THIS defect: `bias_mag=0.0` still satisfies `bias_mag is not None`, so the preflight passes even though the bias is guaranteed zero. Recommend same-question re-queue with `dacc_weight` (and at least one of `dacc_interaction_weight`/`dacc_foraging_weight`/`dacc_suppression_weight`) set to a nonzero, SD-doc-recommended value, AND extend the preflight gate to assert bias MAGNITUDE (not merely definedness) is nonzero on at least one pilot tick -- a value-nonzero check, not merely a call-count check, generalizing 475b's own lesson #4 ('a quick smoke-test assertion would have caught this in minutes').

failure_record_entry.metric: P2 dACC engagement (bias magnitude): dacc_bias_nonzero_steps=0 across all seeds/arms, despite n_dacc_fires=451 (dACC forward pass now runs)
failure_record_entry.target: DACCConfig.dacc_weight (and sub-weights) must be set to a nonzero value for the adapter to emit any bias at all -- currently left at the STOPGAP class default of 0.0

learning_extracted: A preflight gate built to catch one defect class (a signal never being computed at all) does not automatically catch a sibling defect class (the signal is computed but its downstream consumer's weight is zero) -- preflight assertions need to check MAGNITUDE, not just definedness/call-count, when the failure mode could be 'defined but structurally zero'.

The DACCtoE3Adapter is an explicitly-labelled STOPGAP module (its own docstring: 'REMOVE this class when SD-032a lands') whose default behaviour is a documented no-op -- any experiment exercising it must explicitly opt in via dacc_weight>0, and this is now the second driver in this lineage to have missed that opt-in.

P1 passing cleanly while P2 fails completely is, again (as in 475b), informative: the upstream substrate (here, MECH-269b V_s gating) is fine; the defect is isolated to a single downstream config flag.
